tracking.label: Face tracking
tracking.cameraDenied: No permission to use the camera. Check Windows Settings → Privacy → Camera.
tracking.cameraBusy: The camera is being used by another program (Zoom, Teams, the Camera app…). Close it and try again.

lipsync.label: Lip sync
lipsync.micDenied: No permission to use the microphone. Check Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
lipsync.micBusy: The microphone is being used by another program in exclusive mode. Close it and try again.

background.label: Background
background.dialogTitle: Choose a background image or video

errors.engine_not_running: The video engine is not running.
errors.calibration_no_face: Your face was not seen during calibration. Improve the light, face the camera and try again.
errors.calibration_eyes: No difference was detected between open and closed eyes. Try again and keep your eyes fully closed between the two beeps. {detail}
errors.calibration_mouth: An open mouth was not detected. Try again and open it as wide as you can.
errors.calibration_invalid: The calibration values are not valid. Please repeat it.
errors.background_invalid: The background color is not valid.
errors.background_invalid_file: Choose an existing image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF) or video (MP4 or WebM).
errors.effects_invalid: Some effect value is out of range.
errors.shortcut_needs_modifier: Use Ctrl or Alt together with the key (or an F1–F24 key): a single letter would stop typing in every program.
errors.shortcut_altgr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on Spanish keyboards (the key used to type @, #…). Choose another combination.
errors.shortcut_reserved: Windows uses that combination. Choose another one.
errors.shortcut_duplicate: “{detail}” already uses it. Choose another one or remove it there first.
errors.shortcut_taken: Another program already uses that combination. Choose another one.
errors.background_video_unsupported: This video can’t be played: its internal format (codec) is not supported. Try a WebM (VP8/VP9) or an MP4 (H.264).
errors.background_video_failed: The background video could not be played (damaged or incomplete file).
errors.shortcut_reserved_layout: Windows uses Ctrl+Shift+0 to switch the keyboard language. Choose another one.
errors.shortcut_unsupported_key: That key can't be used in a global shortcut. Choose another one (letters, numbers, F1–F24, symbols…).

tooltips.loadAvatar: 3D avatars in VRM format (version 0.x or 1.0). Keep them in the recursos\avatares folder. Don’t have one? Create it for free with VRoid Studio.
tooltips.tracking: Uses your webcam so the avatar copies your head, eyes and mouth. Everything is processed on your device: the video never leaves your computer.
tooltips.fps: How many times per second your face is analyzed. Above 25 looks smooth; if it drops, add more light in front of you.
tooltips.values: What the camera measures, from 0 to 1. Mouth: 0 = closed, 1 = wide open. Eyes: 0 = open, 1 = closed. Use it to tune blinking and the mouth (user guide, “Calibration and adjustments” section).
tooltips.lipsync: Moves the avatar’s mouth with your voice, using the microphone. Also works without a camera. Audio is analyzed on your device and is never sent anywhere.
tooltips.expression: Shortcut {shortcut}: works even when avat-os is not in the foreground. Press it again to go back to neutral. Some avatars block blinking or the mouth with certain expressions.
tooltips.neutral: Clears the active expression and returns to the normal face.
tooltips.background: What is shown behind the avatar. Transparent: whatever is below it in the scene shows through (the screen, a game…). Color: a solid color (green is useful to key out the avatar in another program). Image or video: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF (animated ones too), or an MP4 or WebM video that loops without sound; ideally 1920×1080.
tooltips.comingSoon: Still under construction: coming in a future version.
tooltips.calibrate: Tunes blinking, the mouth and your straight-ahead pose to your face and camera. Requires face tracking to be on. It is saved for next time.
tooltips.calibrationStart: 3 steps of about 5 seconds; each one starts when you press its button. In the eyes step two beeps will guide you, since you won't be able to see the screen.
tooltips.calibrationReset: Deletes your calibration and goes back to the default values.
tooltips.avatarStatus: The avatar is drawn in OBS’s built-in browser. The first time, or when the computer is very busy (for example right after compiling), it can take up to a minute to appear.
tooltips.calibrationAdjust: Change eye and mouth sensitivity without repeating the calibration, with a live preview on the avatar.
tooltips.eyeSensitivity: More: the avatar closes its eyes sooner and fully with a soft blink. Less: you need to close them more (useful if the avatar squints by itself).
tooltips.mouthSensitivity: More: the mouth opens wider with little movement (if you talk with your mouth almost closed). Less: it opens less (if it looks exaggerated).
tooltips.lipsyncLevel: What the microphone measures now (0 to 1). In silence it should stay near 0; if it moves with background noise, lower the sensitivity.
tooltips.lipsyncMic: Choose the microphone you talk into.
tooltips.lipsyncMode: Camera + voice: the mouth uses whichever is larger, camera or voice (it moves when you talk even if the camera can’t see you well, and when you laugh silently). Voice only: ignores the camera’s mouth.
tooltips.lipsyncSensitivity: More: the mouth opens with a quieter voice. Less: you need to speak louder (useful if the mouth moves with background noise or typing).
tooltips.backgroundImage: Choose an image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, animated ones too) or a video (MP4 or WebM; it loops without sound). Ideally 1920×1080. Opens in the recursos\fondos folder.
tooltips.backgroundFit: Cover: the image fills everything (edges may be cropped). Contain: the whole image is visible (transparent bars may appear).
tooltips.effects: Camera, lights and outline of the avatar. Changes show instantly in the preview and are saved automatically.
tooltips.effectsShot: Close-up: head and shoulders. Medium shot: from the waist up (the usual VTuber shot). Full body: the whole avatar. Computed from each avatar’s height.
tooltips.effectsZoom: Moves the camera closer (right) or farther (left).
tooltips.effectsHeight: Moves the framing up or down.
tooltips.effectsAngle: Rotates the camera around the avatar to see it from the side.
tooltips.effectsLightIntensity: Strength of the main light. 1 = normal.
tooltips.effectsLightColor: Color of the main light (for example warm or neon).
tooltips.effectsLightAngle: Where the main light comes from: left, front or right.
tooltips.effectsAmbient: Soft light that fills in the shadows. Higher = fewer shadows.
tooltips.effectsOutline: Thickness of the cartoon outline: 0 removes it, 1 is the avatar’s original. Only works if the avatar has an outline.
tooltips.effectsReset: Goes back to the default camera, light and outline.
tooltips.gesture: Shortcut {shortcut}: a short animation that ends by itself. Works even when avat-os is not in the foreground and blends with tracking.
tooltips.shortcutsRetry: Try to register the shortcuts again now (for example after closing the program that was using them).
tooltips.shortcutsEditor: Choose your own keyboard shortcuts for expressions, gestures and more. They work even when avat-os is not in the foreground.
tooltips.shortcutChange: Assign a new combination. It must include Ctrl or Alt (or be an F1–F24 key).
tooltips.shortcutRemove: Leave this action without a shortcut.
tooltips.shortcutsReset: Go back to the default shortcuts.
tooltips.expressionsSection: Buttons to set an expression (happy, sad…) or play a gesture (wave, nod…). They also work with keyboard shortcuts.
tooltips.lipsyncShape: Vowels: the mouth takes the shape of the vowel you say (A, E, I, O, U), recognized from the sound of your voice; the letter shows on the Voice bar. Open and close only: the mouth opens with the volume, with no shape. Avatars without vowel shapes always use A.
tooltips.vowelCal: If lip sync mixes up vowels with your voice: say A, E, I, O, U (about 2 seconds each) and avat-os will learn how they sound in your voice. Takes about 15 seconds.
tooltips.vowelCalReset: Go back to the typical vowel values.
tooltips.recentAvatars: The last avatars you loaded: click one to load it again. The last one loads automatically when avat-os opens.
tooltips.recentRemove: Removes it from this list (the file is not deleted).
tooltips.lipsyncOptions: Microphone, mouth shape, vowel calibration and sensitivity.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.intro: Tune tracking to your face and camera in 3 short steps. Sit as you do when streaming, with good light. Each step starts when you press its button.
calibration.neutral: Step 1 of 3: look straight at the screen, eyes open and mouth closed. When you're ready, press the button: after a count of 3, it measures for 2 seconds.
calibration.eyes: Step 2 of 3: press the button and, when you hear the beep, close your eyes and keep them closed until the second beep.
calibration.mouth: Step 3 of 3: press the button and, when it starts measuring, open your mouth as wide as you can until it finishes.
calibration.adjustHelp: Blink and talk: the avatar already uses these values. If you don’t like it, move the sliders; changes apply instantly and are not saved until you press Save.
calibration.legend: Bar = what the camera measures now. Gray mark = starts closing (or opening); white mark = fully.
calibration.eyesNumbers: Measured — left eye: open {lo} → closed {lc} (difference {ld}); right eye: {ro} → {rc} ({rd}). Average: {diff}; at least {needed} is needed (jitter of your open eyes: {noise}).
calibration.smallEyeSignal: Your eyes give the camera a small signal. If the avatar doesn't blink well, try more light from the front or no glasses, and calibrate again.

shortcuts.unavailable: These shortcuts don’t work right now: {list}. Another program (or another copy of avat-os) is already using them. They are retried every 15 seconds; the buttons still work.

shortcutsEditor.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcutsEditor.capturingHint: Press the new combination (for example Ctrl+Shift+T). Esc cancels. Shortcuts are paused meanwhile.
shortcutsEditor.failed: Another program uses this combination: it doesn’t work right now.
shortcutsEditor.swallowed: No key arrived with {detail}. If you pressed one, Windows or another program keeps that combination (for example Ctrl+Shift+0, which switches the keyboard language): choose another one.

vowelCal.label: Vowels
vowelCal.say: Say “{v}” and hold it ({long}…) until the bar fills up.
vowelCal.noVoice: Couldn’t hear the “{v}” well. Get closer to the microphone or speak louder.
vowelCal.live: Now: F1 {f1} · F2 {f2} Hz · pitch {f0} Hz
vowelCal.result: Your vowels (F1 / F2 in Hz, for reference)
vowelCal.tooClose: “{a}” and “{b}” came out very similar and may be confused. Repeat the calibration saying them clearly differently, or save it anyway.
